collision_audit.detail: static start/goal plus unchanged analytic three-vehicle OBB sweep over the whole closed path; declared per-lambda bounds independently verified; conservative margin includes the numerical envelope; map and G4 context bound

motion_sweep.padding_role: sampling-interval motion protection only; not counted in the numerical envelope and not subtracted from the margin

collision_margin.formula: e_i = eps_position + (|offset_i| + r_upper) * eps_psi + r_upper * eps_relative_heading, maximised over segments and vehicles; the legacy checker expands each body side by (margin - baseline)/2, so the required closure is (margin_used - baseline)/2 >= max_i e_i, equivalently margin_used >= baseline + 2*max_i e_i
collision_margin.radius_upper_note: radius_upper is an outward interval square root of the actual checker half extents (length+margin)/2 and (width+margin)/2 at the recorded margin; it is not the old fixed-point radius.  The margin is solved at this same expanded radius.
collision_margin.unit_note: The legacy FormationCollisionChecker uses half extents (shape_dimension + margin_m)/2.  A full-width margin increase delta therefore grows each side by only delta/2.  error_envelope reserves 2*max(e_i) of full-width margin so the actual per-side growth covers the numerical envelope.  Sweep motion padding is a separate sampling-interval protection and is never counted as numerical margin.

dynamic_audit.detail: independent raw-profile common-time dynamic audit; whole-domain interval certificate plus node/endpoint/inverse/differential checks; DYNAMIC_FEASIBLE; collision_checked=false; executable=false; no map/ROS

geometry_audit.detail: independent C2/interval/integration audit; geometry only, no timing/map/ROS/collision claim

audit_integration.floating_point_assumption: G1 POSITION_ROUNDOFF_GUARD_M per accumulation panel and ANGLE_ROUNDOFF_GUARD_RAD plus 8*EPSILON*(1+|psi|); libm/trig values are assumed correctly rounded within these guards; cubic coefficients and panel endpoints are widened by bounds.COEFFICIENT_ULPS before the exact per-panel interval M4
audit_integration.formula: sum over complete Simpson panels of H^5*M4_panel/2880 plus one local panel of H^5*max_panel_M4/2880; M4_panel=sqrt(max(Re)^2+max(Im)^2), Re=k^4-4*k*u-3*e^2, Im=g-6*k^2*e

independent.note: Gauss-Legendre independent centreline used for map construction; not used as the audit authority

map_info.mirror_rule: exact row flip with origin_y' = -(origin_y + h*res)
map_info.raster_rule: cell free iff nearest extended-centreline sample distance at the cell centre + cell half-diagonal <= half_width; 1-Lipschitz distance makes this a conservative whole-cell condition
